output.reply:
Dear Mark,

Thank you for your interest in our 1.7L stainless steel kettle and for sharing your first-order plan. We can supply 1,200 pcs at USD 9.80/pc FOB Ningbo, with a 35-day production lead time. Our MOQ is 500 pcs.

Please note that this model is not UL listed. We do have a CB report (IEC 60335-2-15) and CE (LVD/EMC), but these are not substitutes for UL listing. We also have not conducted BPA testing, so we cannot confirm a BPA-free claim based on current test records.

The kettle has a 304 stainless steel inner body, with a PP plastic lid and handle. For 1,200 pcs, printing your logo on the color box is free; please provide the logo in vector format. The standard carton packs 6 units.

Our accepted payment terms are 30% T/T deposit and 70% against a copy of the B/L, or L/C at sight. We cannot offer 100% payment 60 days after delivery. The quoted FOB price is for sea freight; we are unable to quote air freight based on the available shipping arrangements.

Would the CB/CE documents and our standard payment and lead-time terms work for you? We can also arrange a sample at the ex-factory price, with international freight paid by you; the sample fee can be deducted from a production order. Alternatively, we can arrange a video factory inspection through Alibaba video call.

Best regards,
Yongjiang Small Appliances
